name: Calendar
description: A month of days to pick from, on APG's grid keys — one day or, with `mode="range"`, a start and an end.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest day that can be chosen, `YYYY-MM-DD`. The arrows stop there too.

props.name: max
props.description: The latest day that can be chosen.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Days that can be reached but not chosen — a weekend, a holiday. A range is refused across one.

props.name: locale
props.description: The language of the month and weekday names, and whose week it is. Default the reader's.

props.name: zone
props.description: Whose "today" is marked. Default the reader's zone.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: The day the week starts on, 0 for Sunday. Default the locale's.

props.name: months
props.description: How many months side by side. Default 1.

props.name: weekNumbers
props.description: A leading column of ISO week numbers.

props.name: showOutsideDays
props.description: Whether the days that complete the first and last weeks are drawn. Default `true`.

props.name: focusedDate
props.description: The day the keyboard is on, which decides the month on show. Controlled.

props.name: defaultFocusedDate
props.description: Where the keyboard starts when the calendar owns it. Default the value, or today.

props.name: onFocusedDateChange
props.description: Fires when the keyboard or the paging buttons move to another day.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing can be chosen and nothing is focusable.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Can be read and navigated, but not chosen in.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the day the keyboard is on, on mount — what a picker's panel wants.

props.name: label
props.description: The calendar's accessible name, which a screen reader hears before the month.

props.name: previousLabel
props.description: The previous-page button's name. Default `'Previous'`.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: The next-page button's name. Default `'Next'`.

parts.name: Calendar (one day)
parts.description: One day at a time, which is the default: the value is a `YYYY-MM-DD` string or `null`.

props.name: mode
props.description: One day (default), or `'range'` for a start and an end.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen day, `YYYY-MM-DD`, or `null`. Controlled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The day it starts with when the calendar owns its value.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the day and its readings.

parts.name: Calendar (range)
parts.description: A start and an end: the first press anchors the range and the second ends it, whichever way round.

props.name: mode
props.description: `'range'` is what turns the value into `{ start, end }`.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen span, or `null`. Controlled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The span it starts with when the calendar owns its value.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires once both ends are chosen, start first whichever was picked first.

keyboard.action: One tab stop for the grid, on the focused day; the paging buttons and the title are their own.
The day before or after, in the reading order.
The same day a week before or after.
The first or last day of the week.
The same day a month before or after; with Shift, a year.
Chooses the focused day; in a range, the first press anchors and the second ends it.

a11y: The month is a `role="grid"` named by its title, which is a polite live region, so paging says where it landed. Each day is a `gridcell` named by its full date (`Monday, October 19, 2026`), with `aria-selected` on the chosen day or span and `aria-current="date"` on today.
An out-of-bounds day is `aria-disabled` and not focusable; an unavailable one can be reached, so it can be read, but not chosen.
